_comment: Row 770: honeypot filter in _try_fill's fill-candidate walk. One mutant per decision site the patch adds -- the six decoy signals, the restored attach-wait, and the split failure diagnostic -- plus two overcorrections (the filter fires on everything; the walk runs backwards). The backward-walk overcorrection is controlled by test_walk_fills_the_first_of_two_real_fields and NOT by the decoy-behind-the-real-field order control: that fixture's second element is a decoy, so a backward walk skips it and lands on the real field anyway, and the test passes under the mutant. M7 was first anchored on a decoy fixture and ESCAPED: Playwright calls tabindex=-1, aria-hidden, an off-screen box and opacity:0 all VISIBLE, so every decoy fixture is visible=True and none of them can observe a wait weakened from attached to visible. The band member that does observe it is the not-yet-visible non-decoy field, whose whole selector is skipped under the mutant; M7 is anchored there and its label says what it actually breaks. The TRANSFORM CONTROL is a separate spec, row770_login_honeypot_filter_transform_control.json, per the shipped convention: a comment-only edit cannot fail anything and so proves nothing, whereas a real transform banded on a node that cannot observe it proves the harness applied it.  ROW 770b RE-ANCHORING (OPERATOR_DECISIONS rule 5, 2026-09-06; row357 anchor gate refused the generation-1 anchors): every anchor now names a DECISION and its matched span carries no value. The six decoy signals became MEMBERS of _HONEYPOT_SIGNALS, so M1/M2/M3/M5/M12 delete a membership line instead of quoting an attribute name and its value; M4 keeps its structural `if pat in style:` predicate inside the extracted _signal_css_hidden; the attach-wait became the named call _wait_attached(matches.first), so M6 drops the CALL and M7 swaps it for the equally real _wait_visible, which is the same weakening expressed structurally; M9's overcorrection is anchored on the dispatch over the set. No mutant was deleted and no catcher changed: the transforms are the same behaviour changes as generation 1, moved off the values they used to freeze.
subject: the login fill path walks every match for a selector and skips tabindex=-1 / aria-hidden / hiding-style / hidden-attr / type=hidden / off-screen decoy fields before filling the first real one, without dropping the pre-fix wait
